query:
SELECT
            al.id,
            al.table_name,
            al.record_id,
            al.action,
            al.old_data,
            al.new_data,
            al.changed_by,
            CASE WHEN al.changed_by IS NOT NULL THEN u.full_name END AS changed_by_name,
            al.changed_at
        FROM audit_logs al
        LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = al.changed_by
        WHERE ($1::TEXT IS NULL OR al.table_name = $1)
          AND ($2::TEXT IS NULL OR al.record_id  = $2)
          AND ($3::TEXT IS NULL OR al.action     = $3)
        ORDER BY al.changed_at DESC
        LIMIT  $4
        OFFSET $5
